[[File:Damian.png|thumb|250px|Damian]] '''Damian''' (Japanese: '''ダイスケ''' ''Daisuke'') was the [[original Trainer]] of [[Ash's Charmander]]. ==In animation== ===History=== [[File:Damian Best Wishes.png|thumb|left|220px|Damian, as seen in a flashback in ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'']] Damian was the [[character of the day]] in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP011|Charmander – The Stray Pokémon]]''. He is an arrogant {{pkmn|Trainer}} who is mostly interested in {{pkmn2|caught|catching}} strong {{OBP|Pokémon|species}}, and expresses no legitimate interest in raising Pokémon himself. In the Japanese version, he also seems to neither know nor care about the inherent [[Type#Type effectiveness|type weaknesses]] of his Pokémon, as he mocked Charmander for being too weak to even beat a {{p|Poliwag}} before {{an|Brock}} reminded him that Charmander, being a {{t|Fire}} [[type]], is naturally weak to {{t|Water}} Pokémon, the latter of which Poliwag belonged to. At a [[Pokémon Center]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} overheard Damian bragging about how many Pokémon he caught. He said that he left a Charmander in the nearby forest because he was too weak. Brock yelled at Damian and ordered him to reclaim his Charmander because he might die in the rain. Damian laughed it off and Ash was about to challenge him to a battle until [[Nurse Joy]] prevented the confrontation, saying that using Pokémon to settle arguments is wrong, although after they left, she warned the group about their bad reputation. Brock and the others recovered Charmander and had him taken care of at the Pokémon Center. As soon as he felt better, Charmander left to wait for Damian once again. {{TRT}} later tried to steal Pikachu, but Charmander chased them away with a {{m|Flamethrower}} attack. Ash asked Charmander to join them, but Damian showed up, having learned about the fight, and said that he had purposely left Charmander alone to toughen him up. Damian added to it by stating that he was glad he didn't have to go through the trouble of raising Charmander himself. Damian ordered Charmander to return, but Charmander wanted to stay with Ash. Enraged, Damian tried to recapture Charmander with a {{i|Poké Ball}}, but Charmander batted the Poké Ball at his former Trainer's face with his tail. Damian tried to battle against Charmander unfairly with his multitude of other Pokémon, but a combined attack from Charmander and Pikachu scared Damian away for good. He reappeared in a flashback in ''[[BW116|The Fires of a Red-Hot Reunion!]]''. ===Pokémon=== This listing is of Damian's known {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} in {{aniseries|PTS}}: ====On hand==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Damian |pkmn=Unknown Pokémon |type1=??? |epnum=EP011 |epname=Charmander – The Stray Pokémon |img= |desc=At the [[Pokémon Center]], Damian had several Poké Balls that are implied to all have Pokémon, despite there being more than the legal six. He later attempted to use them against Charmander in a rage when the {{pkmn|category|Lizard Pokémon}} refused to return to him, although he was unable to do so before being driven off by a joint attack from both Charmander and Pikachu. None of their moves are known.}} ====Abandoned==== {{TrainerPoké |main=Ash's Charmander |trainer=Damian |pkmn=Charmander |gender=male |type1=Fire |epnum=EP011 |epname=Charmander – The Stray Pokémon |img=Damian Charmander.png |vajp=Shin-ichiro Miki |vaen=Michael Haigney |vaennote=[[EP011]]-[[EP043]] |vaen2=Tom Wayland |vaen2note=[[BW116]] |desc=Damian once held the ownership of this {{p|Charmander}}. Later, however, he started to think Charmander was too weak and left him on top of a big rock and told him to wait for him, leaving him unaware that he was never going to return. When Ash and {{ashfr}} heard about this, they retrieved Charmander, saving him from a downpour. Later, after hearing how Charmander defeated {{TRT}}, Damian wanted Charmander to return to his team. His Charmander had been left waiting for him for ten days, so a {{p|Squirtle}} convinced it and [[Ash's Pikachu]] to join him on a trip to the [[Hidden Village]]. There, Charmander was reunited with Damian. Damian had gone shopping when an accident put him in a coma. He thought Charmander would end up at the Hidden Village and came looking for him. The tearful reunion inspired Squirtle to seek out its Trainer. ====Pokémon==== This listing is of Damian's Pokémon in The Electric Tale of Pikachu. {{anchor|Charmander 2}}{{TrainerPoké |width=80 |trainer=Damian |pkmn=Charmander |type1=Fire |img=Damian Charmander EToP.png |epnum=ET07 |epname=Pikachu's Excellent Adventure |desc={{p|Charmander}} was waiting for Damian for ten days after he got into an accident and was sent to the hospital. Charmander went with {{p|Squirtle}} and {{AP|Pikachu}} to the [[Hidden Village]]. Later, Charmander gets reunited with Damian. None of Charmander's moves are known.}} {{-}} ==In the games== In {{game|Yellow}}, [[Pokémon: Let's Go, Pikachu! and Let's Go, Eevee!|Let's Go, Pikachu!, and Let's Go, Eevee!]], a boy, possibly based on Damian, will give out a Charmander on {{rt|24|Kanto}}. However, he noticeably regrets his poor treatment of Charmander, much like Damian did when he saw how powerful Charmander was under Ash's control.
